name: AI Builder
description: Describe a section of a level and have Claude build it in the editor.

model.name: Claude model
model.description: Which Claude model builds your levels. Opus is the most capable; Sonnet and Haiku are cheaper and faster.

effort.name: Effort
effort.description: How hard Claude thinks before answering. Higher is slower and uses more tokens.

max-objects.name: Max objects per request
max-objects.description: Upper limit on objects Claude may place in one build.
